sources.evidence_grade: A2-P: creator paratext with explicitly recorded account provenance
sources.inspected_scope: Author replies on pages 0,15,30,45,90,105,120,135,165; inspected replies 19,25,36,56,98,101,105,110,112,113,115,116,117,123,124,126,139,171. Other pages fetched and screened for author posts; no fan question treated as an author assertion.

supports: Direct confirmation of holographic projection and tactical purpose
